title: qt-ui-perf scenario
description: A scenario tools/perfdrive.py plays against an application built with harness/perfdriver. Steps run in order; the first must be launch and the last quit. A step with a mark records a metric under that name (key/wheel also record <mark>.p95 and <mark>.max; wait_first_frame also records <mark>.wall; stats records <mark>.p95, <mark>.max and <mark>.over_50ms).

name.description: Scenario name, written into the results JSON and used by baseline comparison.

app_args.description: Extra command-line arguments for the application (after --perf-driver).

env.description: Environment variables set for the application, on top of the lane's.

thresholds.description: Per metric: relative regression against the baseline that marks the build UNSTABLE / FAILED (tools/compare.py). Keys must be metric names the scenario records.

objectName.description: objectName of the widget, optionally a path parent/child.

timeout_ms.description: How long the seam waits for the repaint after the input (default 1000).

launch.description: Start the application with --perf-driver and wait for its ready event. Must be the first step.

wait_first_frame.description: Wait for the first widget paint. mark records first_paint_ms (in-process clock) and <mark>.wall (driver clock since launch).

wait_idle.description: Wait until ms milliseconds pass without paint/update events (default 300).

click.description: Synthetic press+release at the widget's centre; mark records click-to-paint ms.

key.description: Focus the widget and send key press/release pairs, times times; mark records the median key-to-paint ms plus .p95 and .max.

text.description: Text typed as key events with this text (typing latency).

wheel.description: One synthetic wheel event, times times; mark records the median wheel-to-paint ms plus .p95 and .max.

delta.description: Wheel delta in eighths of a degree; -120 is one notch down (default).

get.description: Read a Qt property (default text). With expect, the run fails unless the value equals it: this is how a scenario proves an interaction took effect.

mark.description: Record a value under name: the in-process timestamp (metric time, ms since process start) or the application's resident set size (metric rss, MiB).

stats.description: Read the jank meter; records <mark>.p95, <mark>.max and <mark>.over_50ms (mark defaults to jank). reset clears the counters afterwards.

quit.description: Ask the application to quit and wait for it; a non-zero exit code fails the run. Must be the last step.
